mission: Build Prometeo as a portable cognitive operating system where chats/models are disposable compute, durable state carries identity/method/memory/campaign/evidence/work, and many scoped workers can explore/build in parallel without making the human scheduler, integrator, context bus or durable memory.
human_goal: The human can forget the entire plan and still recover it through Prometeo; can also exploit many fresh chats in parallel using tiny self-bootstrapping commands while the parent tracks launches/returns and converges results automatically.
current_frontier: B-ZEROMEM-01 has passed and is integrated. Next: dispatch B-BIGPIC-01 (18 isolated architecture/recovery scouts), observe their run/return state without human result copy/paste, then parent/steward builds a contradiction/overlap matrix, runs coverage audit against BIG_PICTURE_MAP_V1 + SURVIVAL_SET_V1, compiles a reconciled architecture/method vNext, and only then recompiles implementation batches.
current_human_action: Open fresh chats and paste the self-bootstrapping P-BIG-01..P-BIG-18 launch commands supplied by the parent. They may be opened nearly concurrently. Do not copy worker answers back; parent will inspect durable runs/returns.
verified_progress: First bare-code launch failure was detected as NOT_LAUNCHED and recorded as INC-ZM-BOOT-01 rather than mistaken for work.
Fresh self-bootstrapping canary then wrote STARTED commit dc9a181e..., RETURN commit 6255a580..., DONE commit bfdbccec... in correct order.
Canary return confirmed parent transcript was not needed and parent independently observed the return.
Parent verified worker wrote only its allowed run/return subtree and recorded INTEGRATED_PASS.
Created BIG_PICTURE_MAP_V1 restoring 27 major Prometeo dimensions beyond the current Chat Object implementation slice.
Created ANTI_LIMITATION_RULES_V1 with explicit rules against overfitting to latest bug/current architecture, unnecessary serialization and underuse of parallel chats.
Prepared BIG_PICTURE_EXPANSION_BOARD_V1 with 18 distinct scouts and individual preallocated JOBs/runs/returns.
Stable entry now exposes Big Picture, anti-limitation rules and multiple delegated-work launch boards; p.txt v4.2 resolves launch codes across boards.
must_preserve: Constitution -> Active Method -> Product Memory -> Project North -> Campaign -> Run -> evidence/return -> integration -> successor remain distinct layers.
ONE ZIP != Written Mind != Deep Campaign != One Worker != One Authority != Chat Object != Agent Network != Product Architecture.
Load Big Picture + Survival Set + Anti-Limitation Rules before major Prometeo architecture/method changes.
Conversation/model is disposable compute; durable state is sufficient for recovery.
Jobs exist before workers; STARTED before substantive execution; RETURN before DONE; missing run means NOT_LAUNCHED.
Workers write independent scope; parent/steward converges returns; Current/Human Accepted/Served remain separate.
Safety gates may constrain shared writes but must not suppress independent architecture/research parallelism.
Recover historical Prometeo mechanisms before inventing replacements.
Local implementation bugs/details must not redefine the full north star.
negative_knowledge: Do not reduce Prometeo to Inbox, Chat Object, worker network, bootstrap, memory, or any single current slice.
Do not let a canary or safety concern gate unrelated read-only cognition.
Do not route every large idea through the parent serially when independent scouts can work in parallel.
Do not treat current architecture as a prison or latest conversation salience as importance.
Do not launch overlapping shared writers without scope/authority, but do not confuse that with a reason to avoid parallel read-only scouts.
Do not proceed with the older narrow six-job implementation batch unchanged before consuming full-picture scout returns.
Do not require human copying of worker results.
next_actions: Verify p.txt v4.2 + stable entry publication on gh-pages before asking human to launch scouts.
On parent turns derive which scout codes are NOT_LAUNCHED/STARTED/WORKING/RETURNED/DONE from exact run paths; do not ask human.
When substantial returns arrive, begin contradiction/overlap matrix without waiting idly for every worker if useful work is possible.
When all/most required returns are terminal, run coverage reconciliation against Big Picture + Survival Set.
Compile Active Method/architecture vNext and generate new implementation batches; reuse/merge/retire old P-CC jobs explicitly.
Then test full parent-chat erasure/reincarnation with the expanded architecture and active batch state intact.
continuation_rule: Future parent incarnation loads stable entry -> CHAT_OBJECT -> BIG_PICTURE_MAP_V1 -> ANTI_LIMITATION_RULES_V1 -> SURVIVAL_SET_V1 -> FOCUS -> WORK_BOARD + BIG_PICTURE_EXPANSION_BOARD -> relevant runs/returns. Current priority is B-BIGPIC-01; canary is already PASS_INTEGRATED.
